notes: Candidate layouts for the deployment demo (virtual cylinders, radius 0.1 m). The vehicle starts at rest at the origin, flies towards +x at 1.5 m height and 1 m/s; the goal is on the x axis. The first cylinder's top touches the line (centre y -0.1), so the vehicle goes round it on the left. A start distance of 1.1 m puts the start hover exactly at the base set's clearance for a new plan (1.0 m from the surface); 1.3 m leaves 0.2 m for the position hold before the hand-over. scripts/candidates_cyl_final.py flies all of them; scripts/eval_cyl_final.py --candidate <name> runs one as the deployment test.

O1.about: one cylinder, the tightest: 1.1 m ahead, goal 1.2 m beyond it (course 2.3 m)

O2.about: one cylinder 1.3 m ahead (0.2 m slack at the start), goal 1.2 m beyond it (course 2.5 m)

O3.about: one cylinder 1.3 m ahead, goal 2.0 m beyond it (course 3.3 m): more room to come back to the line

O4.about: one cylinder 2.0 m ahead, goal 2.0 m beyond it (course 4.0 m): the most room; this far out the planner now and then goes round the right side (1 of 20 episodes)

S1.about: slalom, the tightest: first 1.1 m ahead, second 2.0 m further at y 1.6, goal 1.2 m beyond (course 4.3 m)

S2.about: slalom: first 1.1 m ahead, second 2.2 m further at y 1.5, goal 1.2 m beyond (course 4.5 m)

S3.about: slalom: first 1.3 m ahead (start slack), second 2.0 m further at y 1.5, goal 1.2 m beyond (course 4.5 m)

S4.about: slalom: first 1.3 m ahead, second 2.5 m further at y 1.5, goal 1.2 m beyond (course 5.0 m): the most room, the planner's own weave needs the filter least
